newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buy 5,000T of cottonseed meal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buy 5,000T of cottonseed meal.

text.p: South Korean feed mill companies on Wednesday bought 5,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal at $151.85 a tonne on a cost-and-freight basis, traders said.
Sunkyong Ltd, a South Korean trading house, won the contract for delivery on December 30 to the western port city of Inchon.
Traders said the tender had been invited on Tuesday but the result emerged a day later since the buyers wanted to increase the amount to 6,000 tonnes from the original 5,000 tonnes.
